properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Treat screening results as provisional, report aliases, and resolve any ambiguity that could change the decision.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A Plackett–Burman array or “DOE software result” is not the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: When effect sparsity fails or factors are adaptive/continuous, screening rankings can be unstable and model-dependent.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should alias risk be priced when a missed interaction has severe safety consequences?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Screen many factors to select a smaller follow-up set.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Independent run/unit at a design row.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Runs independent/blocked; no hidden batch alias.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Randomise rows subject to restrictions.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Account for hard-to-change factors with split-plot/blocks.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Usually limited; follow-up/foldover supplies discrimination.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Aliasing with interactions is the central risk.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Precommit alias interpretation and follow-up trigger.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Broad factor information per run under sparsity.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Follow-up burden and risk of missed factors.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Treating provisional aliases as causal truths.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Resolution-aware screening plus sequential de-aliasing and confirmation.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: What effects are aliased, and which assumptions make the reported effect interpretable?
Was ambiguous screening evidence independently confirmed or augmented?
Could a plausible interaction contaminate the selected main effect?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Use response surfaces and iterative experimentation as local learning, with confirmation and boundary discipline
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Box–Wilson response-surface methodology, Box/Hunter sequential experimentation and Shewhart/Box iterative science.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Build local empirical models, move toward promising regions, augment the design and confirm the selected operating point.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A one-shot optimum from sparse data can be a model artefact; unstructured trial-and-error wastes runs and hides stopping bias.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Overfit optima, extrapolation, hill-climbing into unsafe regions and confirmation on reused data.
properties.MECHANISM: Start with screening/local design, check curvature/residuals, proceed sequentially under a stated rule, respect constraints, and reserve independent confirmation/robustness tests.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Continuous controllable factors, expensive runs and an objective surface smooth enough locally.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For discrete deterministic search spaces that are cheap to enumerate or when a mechanistic model fixes the optimum, RSM is unnecessary.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable measurement, controllable factors, safe region, adequate local design, model diagnostics and fresh confirmation capacity.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Outcome definition/threshold remains stable across stages; process drift is monitored.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Local low-order approximation is adequate within each step; sequential data reuse is reflected in uncertainty.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Finds useful settings efficiently while learning curvature/interactions.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Design/process engineer and optimisation decision owner.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Sequential flexibility can overfit and obscure error rates; local optima may be fragile or nontransportable.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Rigid one-shot designs can miss the region where information is valuable.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Reporting fitted optimum without confirmation; extrapolating beyond design; stopping after favourable stage; no noise-factor test.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Reporting fitted optimum without confirmation; extrapolating beyond design; stopping after favourable stage; no noise-factor test. Contrary evidence/limit: Adaptive optimisers can exploit evaluator noise and drift; repeated use of the same validation surface erodes confirmation value.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Modern practice hybridises RSM with Bayesian optimisation/adaptive design, but still needs protected validation and decision costs.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Iterate models as provisional maps; require confirmation in the intended context and robustness around the selected point.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: RSM contour plots or a fixed phase sequence are tools; sequential information-efficient learning is the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Adaptive optimisers can exploit evaluator noise and drift; repeated use of the same validation surface erodes confirmation value.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What degree of fresh confirmation is needed after highly adaptive optimisation?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Locate/compare an operating region or optimum under continuous factors.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Independent run/unit at selected settings.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Sequential runs may be dependent through adaptation; observation noise independent conditional on design or modelled.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Randomise/localise run order where drift permits; adaptive selection is recorded.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Block nuisance factors and include centre/replicate points.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Independent runs and protected confirmation at final settings.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Curvature and interactions are core; unknown high-order behaviour outside region.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Stage/decision rule plus independent confirmation, not “stop when best.”
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: High local information gain and efficient movement toward useful region.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Runs, setup changes, risk near boundaries and confirmation.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Adaptive overfit, local optimum and ceremonial contour fitting.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Constraint-aware sequential local modelling with model checks, robustness and fresh confirmation.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Was the reported optimum independently confirmed in the intended operating region?
Did sequential adaptation preserve a stopping/validation boundary?
Could the optimiser be exploiting evaluator noise or an unsafe extrapolation?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Report effect magnitude, uncertainty and engineering significance; use equivalence/noninferiority when “no important difference” is the decision
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Neyman–Pearson power, estimation/tolerance practice, modern p-value criticism and equivalence testing.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Interpret estimated magnitude and uncertainty against a predeclared engineering consequence/margin, not only a null-test threshold.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Tiny effects become “significant” with large n, while meaningful effects are dismissed after inconclusive small studies; non-significance is called equivalence.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Statistical/practical-significance confusion, false “no difference,” and optimisation of trivial changes.
properties.MECHANISM: Define smallest effect of interest or acceptance margin; report interval/distribution and decision consequences; use equivalence/noninferiority design where appropriate.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Comparisons where action depends on magnitude, not merely direction, and negative results may support interchangeability.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For deterministic threshold compliance or an overwhelming effect far from uncertainty, a p-value may add nothing.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Valid measurement, meaningful scale/margin, representative units, adequate information and multiplicity/stopping control.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Metric resolution and uncertainty are small enough relative to the engineering margin.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Model/interval coverage is adequate; equivalence margin is fixed independently of observed results.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Aligns inference with engineering consequence and distinguishes absence of detection from evidence of negligible effect.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Design/process owner, customer, regulator and risk decision maker.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Arbitrary “practical” margins can be chosen to obtain a desired conclusion; focus on average effect can hide tails/subgroups.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Threshold-only testing can miss consequential uncertainty or reward minuscule gains.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: p<.05 presented without units; CI crossing zero called “same”; post-hoc equivalence margin; relative change hiding absolute harm.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: p<.05 presented without units; CI crossing zero called “same”; post-hoc equivalence margin; relative change hiding absolute harm. Contrary evidence/limit: Engineering-significance margins can be multi-dimensional and context-dependent; scalar margins may conceal trade-offs or rare harms.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: ASA-era guidance preserved inferential tools but rejected single-threshold interpretation; equivalence methods sharpen negative claims.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Show effect, uncertainty, smallest consequential magnitude, and decision; reserve “equivalent” for designs that test a justified margin.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A particular effect-size statistic or ban on p-values is not the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Engineering-significance margins can be multi-dimensional and context-dependent; scalar margins may conceal trade-offs or rare harms.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should practical-significance criteria aggregate average benefit and catastrophic tail risk?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Decide whether an effect is large enough, or small enough, to matter.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Independent unit at the action scale.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Design-appropriate independence/cluster structure.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Randomise/control if causal; otherwise limit claim.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Block major nuisance factors and examine consequential strata.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Enough independent units for interval precision around the decision margin.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Subgroup/tail interactions may defeat average equivalence.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Fixed or valid sequential rule using the same margin.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Directly discriminates engineering-relevant alternatives.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Sample and measurement cost.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Overformal effect metrics or arbitrary margins can game decisions.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Magnitude-plus-uncertainty decision, with equivalence/noninferiority only when prejustified.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: What effect magnitude would actually change the engineering decision?
Is a negative result merely inconclusive, or was equivalence against a justified margin tested?
Could a statistically significant change be operationally trivial?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Control multiplicity, analyst degrees of freedom and selective inference across the actual family of opportunities
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Multiple-comparison theory, FDR, preregistration/transparent reporting and empirical research on undisclosed flexibility.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Account for the number and adaptivity of outcomes, subgroups, models, thresholds and looks that could have generated a favourable claim.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Trying enough analyses almost guarantees an apparently strong result even when no stable effect exists.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: False discoveries, cherry-picking, hidden file drawers and post-hoc subgroup/evaluator selection.
properties.MECHANISM: Define confirmatory families, preserve all analyses, use FWER/FDR/selective methods as appropriate, split/external validation, and label exploration.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Many metrics, variants, subgroups, prompts, models, thresholds or parallel experiments.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: When one authoritative predeclared deterministic discriminator exists, multiplicity machinery is unnecessary; report any exploratory alternatives separately.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Complete analysis provenance, stable outcome definitions, independent/protected validation data and a meaningful error criterion.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Evaluator/threshold versions and excluded outputs are retained; duplicates/dependence are known.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Chosen correction matches dependence and decision loss; unreported researcher flexibility is bounded.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Prevents false winners and preserves the evidential meaning of a reported result.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Experiment owner, reviewer, portfolio decision maker and public evidence consumer.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Overly broad correction can destroy power or discourage useful exploration; formal adjustment cannot repair biased hypotheses or invalid measurement.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: No control allows a flexible workflow to manufacture confidence.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Correcting only final p-values while selecting endpoints/models; post-hoc “primary” metric; repeated benchmark variants; favourable subgroup only.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Correcting only final p-values while selecting endpoints/models; post-hoc “primary” metric; repeated benchmark variants; favourable subgroup only. Contrary evidence/limit: The true adaptive analysis family may be impossible to enumerate; fresh independent replication/holdout protection may be more credible than retrospective correction.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved from fixed families to FDR, hierarchical testing, selective inference, reusable holdouts and explicit exploration/confirmation separation.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Protect the claim-generating opportunity set, not merely the final table; use fresh confirmation when adaptivity is complex.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A preregistration badge, Bonferroni-by-default or “one metric” slogan is not the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: The true adaptive analysis family may be impossible to enumerate; fresh independent replication/holdout protection may be more credible than retrospective correction.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should multiplicity be controlled when agents dynamically generate hypotheses and evaluators during the campaign?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Select or confirm effects while controlling false claims across many opportunities.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Independent unit within each experiment; the claim family spans analyses/experiments.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Dependence among tests affects error control; shared data is not independent replication.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Randomisation protects each causal contrast but not unreported multiplicity.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Use hierarchical families/strata where decision structure justifies them.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Independent confirmatory units/data after exploration.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Post-hoc interaction/subgroup searches are major multiplicity sources.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Predefine looks or use valid sequential/multiple-testing procedure.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Protects credibility of selected winners.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Power cost and need for fresh holdout/replication.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Blanket corrections can be wasteful and obscure exploratory learning.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Transparent family definition, suitable error criterion, and protected confirmation.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: How many outcomes, subgroups, models, thresholds and looks could have produced the selected claim?
Were unfavourable measurements or analyses retained?
Is fresh independent confirmation needed because the adaptive family cannot be reconstructed?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Plan sequential evidence and stopping so repeated looks do not manufacture confidence
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Wald sequential analysis, alpha-spending/group-sequential methods, confidence sequences and always-valid online inference.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Permit data-dependent continuation/stopping only under a rule whose error/coverage or decision risk remains valid over time.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Peeking and sampling until favourable inflates false positives; fixed quotas can waste measurements after a decision is already discriminated.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Optional-stopping abuse, confirmation loops, repeated review inflation and needless evidence collection.
properties.MECHANISM: Choose fixed horizon, group-sequential/alpha-spending, SPRT, confidence sequence, Bayesian decision rule or explicit noninferential learning cadence; preserve stopping metadata.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Repeated monitoring/experiments where results are reviewed before collection ends or cost accumulates over time.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Stop immediately when an authoritative deterministic discriminator settles the decision; no statistical stopping machinery is needed.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined outcome/estimand, valid time/dependence model, precommitted boundaries or anytime-valid method, complete history and action loss.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement/evaluator is stable over the sequence; repeated observations add identifiable information.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Procedure’s martingale/likelihood/independence conditions hold or robust alternatives are used; adaptive outcome switching is excluded.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Cuts expected cost while preserving error/coverage and prevents repeated looks from becoming false replication.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Experiment/monitoring owner and resource/risk decision maker.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Overly conservative spending can delay useful decisions; complex anytime-valid methods may be misunderstood or applied outside assumptions.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Unplanned peeking yields overstated evidence; quota stopping wastes resources and can expose units needlessly.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Restarting tests after failure; treating every review as independent; stopping at first green; continuing only negative arms; changing metric midstream.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Restarting tests after failure; treating every review as independent; stopping at first green; continuing only negative arms; changing metric midstream. Contrary evidence/limit: No universal stopping rule exists across discovery, safety, optimisation and governance; information value and consequence determine the boundary.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved from model-specific SPRT to group-sequential, alpha spending, confidence sequences and decision-theoretic adaptive designs.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Another observation is justified only when it is expected to change the decision and the stopping/error framework remains valid.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A universal number of rounds or a confidence-sequence library is not the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: No universal stopping rule exists across discovery, safety, optimisation and governance; information value and consequence determine the boundary.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should sequential validity be preserved when both candidate and evaluator adapt between looks?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Stop/continue an experiment while preserving evidential validity and minimising expected cost.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Sequentially observed independent/conditionally modelled units.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Time dependence/adaptive assignment must meet the chosen procedure.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Randomisation continues under the protocol; adaptive allocation accounted for.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Stratification can be maintained; information fractions may guide looks.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: New units/information increments, not repeated reinterpretation of the same data.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Adaptive subgroup/outcome switching is outside ordinary boundaries.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Fixed horizon or explicit sequential boundary/decision rule.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Expected decision-value gain per next observation.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Delay, samples, exposure and analysis burden.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Using advanced sequential tools ceremonially where a simple fixed design suffices.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Method matched to dependence and decision, with full look/stopping provenance.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Was the stopping/continuation rule defined before outcomes were reviewed?
Does each additional test add independent or conditionally valid information?
Is collection continuing because the decision remains ambiguous or merely because a quota exists?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Bound causal claims by external validity, interference, carryover and order effects
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Causal inference, cross-over design, cluster/interference methods and transportability concerns.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Separate internal comparison validity from applicability to new contexts and from one unit affecting another or later periods.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A clean experiment can estimate the wrong deployment effect when units interfere, learn, carry over, or differ from the target population.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Overgeneralisation, contaminated controls, order confounding and deployment failure despite a significant trial.
properties.MECHANISM: Define exposure mapping/population, design clusters/washouts/counterbalancing, measure effect modifiers, replicate across contexts and restrict claims.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Networked/shared-resource systems, sequential treatments, adaptive users, multi-site deployment or any generalisation claim.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For an exact local deterministic mechanism with no scope extension, external-validity statistics may be unnecessary; state the local claim.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Target population/context, unit/exposure graph, period/order history, representative sampling and stable measurement across contexts.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Outcome remains comparable; contamination/exposure is observable enough to model.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: No hidden interference/carryover beyond the specified structure; sampled contexts cover intended use or extrapolation is bounded.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Prevents local experimental success from being treated as universal engineering truth.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Deployment owner, system architect, regulator and experiment consumer.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Maximal heterogeneity studies can be prohibitively costly and reduce precision; overcautious scope may underuse valid mechanisms.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Ignoring transfer/interference can reverse sign or erase benefit at scale.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Users share treatments; same system state across arms; inadequate washout; one site; aggregate effect hides vulnerable context.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Randomisation is preserved but narrowed: it supports the assigned comparison, not automatic transport.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved into cluster/network experiments, crossover diagnostics, multisite replication and explicit transport/sensitivity analysis.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: State the local causal estimand and separately justify transport; design around interference/order when materially plausible.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A “randomised” label is not the property if exposure or deployment scope differs.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: General transport under unmeasured effect modification is not identified from one experiment; mechanistic and multi-context evidence remain necessary.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What minimum context diversity is needed before an engineering effect can be treated as robust rather than local?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Estimate a causal effect under deployment-relevant exposure and context.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Unit or cluster under a defined exposure mapping/period sequence.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Interference/carryover explicitly absent or modelled.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Randomise clusters/sequences or use appropriate controls.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Stratify sites/contexts and counterbalance order.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Independent clusters/period sequences and multisite confirmation.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Treatment×context and spillover interactions are central.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Stopping rule respects clusters/periods and delayed outcomes.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Distinguishes direct, spillover, carryover and transported effects.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Clusters/sites, washout, longer follow-up.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Overly broad designs may be infeasible; local claims may suffice.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Scope-bounded causal estimate plus interference/carryover and transport evidence.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Can units influence one another or retain effects across periods?
Does the experimental population/context match deployment?
What evidence supports transporting the local effect beyond the tested conditions?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Use robustness and sensitivity analysis to expose dependence on model, confounding and nuisance assumptions
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Robust statistics, model criticism, causal sensitivity and industrial robustness practice.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Recompute or bound conclusions under plausible alternative distributions, nuisance values, confounding, preprocessing and analysis choices.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A conclusion may exist only under one fragile model or arbitrary analytic choice.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Model-driven false certainty, hidden leverage/outliers, unmeasured confounding and specification-search overfit.
properties.MECHANISM: Specify plausible perturbation set, inspect residuals/influence, use robust/nonparametric/model-averaged/bounded analyses and report decision stability.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Small samples, heavy tails, observational comparisons, extrapolation, complex models or high-consequence decisions.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: When a deterministic mechanism/proof settles the decision, statistical sensitivity may be redundant; verify mechanism assumptions instead.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Domain-informed alternative models/ranges, adequate measurement/provenance and a fixed decision criterion.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement error and evaluator variants are included among perturbations where material.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Perturbation set spans credible alternatives rather than only convenient ones; robust method’s loss/neighbourhood matches consequence.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Shows whether action is stable or identifies which assumption needs new evidence.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Analyst, reviewer, risk owner and design authority.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Performing dozens of unprincipled alternatives can become another multiplicity exercise or obscure a clear primary analysis.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: No sensitivity analysis leaves fragile assumptions invisible.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Only normality test; deleting “outliers” post hoc; robust estimator treated as assumption-free; sensitivity range chosen to preserve result.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Only normality test; deleting “outliers” post hoc; robust estimator treated as assumption-free; sensitivity range chosen to preserve result. Contrary evidence/limit: Sensitivity conclusions are only as broad as the considered perturbations; unknown unknowns and structural model error remain.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved from single-model checks to decision-focused robustness, influence analysis, partial identification and stress scenarios.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Challenge the assumptions capable of changing the decision; do not confuse robust-to-one-model feature with universal validity.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A mandatory normality test or a menu of every model is ceremony.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Sensitivity conclusions are only as broad as the considered perturbations; unknown unknowns and structural model error remain.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should plausible perturbation sets be governed so they are neither result-preserving nor impossibly broad?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Determine whether an experimental conclusion is stable to plausible violations/heterogeneity.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Same independent units, reanalysed or augmented under alternative assumptions.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Dependence alternatives explicitly considered.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Randomisation protects assignment but sensitivity addresses noncompliance/missingness/model choices.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Assess block/context heterogeneity and alternative stratifications.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Fresh confirmation may be required when sensitivity reveals overfit.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Unmodelled interactions are a key robustness target.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Sensitivity plan ideally prespecified; exploratory analyses fully reported.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Identifies which assumption/new experiment has highest value.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Analysis and possible follow-up runs.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Sensitivity theatre via many irrelevant models.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Decision-focused perturbation/bounds with independent follow-up for fragile drivers.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Which model or nuisance assumption could reverse the decision?
Was the perturbation range justified independently of the desired result?
Does a robust conclusion survive evaluator, sampling and preprocessing alternatives—not only distribution choice?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Choose experiments and measurements by expected information or decision value relative to cost
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Shewhart/Duncan economic control, decision analysis/value of information and sequential industrial experimentation.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Collect evidence when its expected effect on the next decision is worth its monetary, time, risk and opportunity cost.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Measurement quotas, full DOE or repeated review can consume more than the uncertainty they resolve; cheap tests may be omitted despite high value.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Evidence theatre, analysis paralysis, overmeasurement and underinvestment in decisive discriminators.
properties.MECHANISM: List current alternatives/uncertainty, possible outcomes and changed actions; estimate information gain/EVSI or use qualitative dominance; stop when no plausible result changes action enough.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Costly/slow/destructive measurement, adaptive experimentation, competing tests or staged engineering decisions.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Take the direct authoritative fact immediately when cost is negligible; do not build a probabilistic model merely to justify an obvious check.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Explicit decision/action set, consequence ranges, credible outcome model and measurement/experiment cost.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement can actually discriminate the uncertain states and does not repeat shared bias.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Utility/probability model or qualitative ranking is sufficiently credible; option value and irreversible harm are considered.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Maximises learning per resource and supplies a principled stopping/cheap-path boundary.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Resource allocator, design/test owner and risk decision maker.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Numerical EVSI can create false precision, undervalue discovery or encode contested utilities; qualitative use may be safer.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Ignoring information value either starves key evidence or funds endless low-value replication.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: “More data” default; full factorial despite deterministic discriminator; no action change after result; cost omitted; catastrophic risk monetised casually.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: “More data” default; full factorial despite deterministic discriminator; no action change after result; cost omitted; catastrophic risk monetised casually. Contrary evidence/limit: Deep uncertainty and irreversible tail harms can defeat expected-value summaries; robust/safety constraints may override average information value.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved from economic chart/sample design toward general evidence portfolios, adaptive design and qualitative decision-value gates.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Ask whether the next observation is independently informative enough to change action; choose the cheapest valid discriminator.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A formal Bayesian model is optional; evidence proportionality is the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Deep uncertainty and irreversible tail harms can defeat expected-value summaries; robust/safety constraints may override average information value.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should option/discovery value and catastrophic constraints be combined with expected information value?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Select the next experiment or decide to stop based on decision value.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Depends on candidate experiment; independent information unit must be explicit.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Expected information must discount correlation/shared bias.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Prefer designs that discriminate alternatives; randomise when causal.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Block/stratify if it cheaply improves information.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Value comes from new independent information, not repeated looks.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Experiments should target uncertain interactions capable of changing action.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Stop when expected net decision value is nonpositive or boundary reached.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Core criterion: expected reduction in decision loss/uncertainty.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Measurement, delay, risk, setup and opportunity.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: False numerical precision or bureaucracy around EVSI.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Qualitative/quantitative value-of-information gate with safety/robust constraints.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Which possible result of the next measurement would change the next decision?
Is the evidence independent enough to reduce the dominant uncertainty?
Does a cheaper test, sample or deterministic check dominate the proposed study?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Give precedence to an authoritative deterministic discriminator when it settles the decision
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Not a single historical statistical school; a convergent anti-overapplication boundary implicit in measurement science, engineering proof and evidence economy.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: When a valid exact check, identity, proof, specification comparison or mechanism directly decides the case, use it before stochastic inference.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Statistical machinery can obscure a decisive fact, introduce model assumptions and waste samples.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Decorative statistics, false uncertainty, repeated green tests replacing source authority, and averaging over a deterministic defect.
properties.MECHANISM: Verify authority, identity, applicability and measurement; execute the direct check; use statistics only for residual uncertainty, frequency, transfer or noisy observation.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Exact configuration/identity, complete enumeration, formal proof, direct physical interlock or unambiguous requirement violation.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Do not invoke this property when the “deterministic” rule is an unvalidated proxy, incomplete oracle, stale reference or only one sample from a stochastic population.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Authoritative source, exact scope/identity, reliable implementation and no hidden measurement ambiguity.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: The discriminator’s input and output are verifiable and its resolution covers the decision.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: The rule truly entails the decision under current conditions; completeness/authority have been established.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Eliminates needless uncertainty and preserves statistics for genuinely stochastic/unknown questions.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Engineering decision owner and evidence reviewer.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Overclaiming determinism can suppress uncertainty, rare contexts or model error; an exact test may only check a proxy.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Ignoring a direct discriminator can prolong unsafe ambiguity and create opportunities for gaming.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Running significance tests on exhaustive results; rerunning a deterministic failure until green; using source count over authoritative identity; stale oracle.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Running significance tests on exhaustive results; rerunning a deterministic failure until green; using source count over authoritative identity; stale oracle. Contrary evidence/limit: Whether a discriminator is complete and authoritative is itself an evidence question; probabilistic residual risk may remain.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Modern evidence-efficient practice treats statistical methods as conditional tools, not obligatory proof decorations.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: First ask whether the decision is already logically or physically discriminated; if yes, stop statistical collection and document the decisive evidence.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The absence of statistical analysis is not a defect when uncertainty is not the decision problem.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Whether a discriminator is complete and authoritative is itself an evidence question; probabilistic residual risk may remain.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can systems prevent “deterministic” gates from becoming stale or proxy-captured while retaining their cheap decisiveness?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Determine whether experimentation is needed at all.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Not applicable when the direct discriminator is complete; otherwise define residual unit.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: No replication requirement for a logically decisive exact fact.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Not applicable unless residual causal uncertainty remains.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Not applicable unless context scope is uncertain.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Replication addresses implementation/transfer reliability, not the already settled exact fact.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Potential context exceptions must be tested if they limit entailment.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Stop immediately once authoritative discrimination is verified.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Maximum information at minimum cost when valid.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Verification of authority/identity and maintenance.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Misclassifying a probabilistic proxy as deterministic.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Deterministic precedence with explicit residual-uncertainty check.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is there an authoritative deterministic check that already settles the decision?
Has the check’s identity, completeness and applicability been verified?
What residual uncertainty, if any, actually requires statistical evidence?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Design robustness to nuisance factors and context variation, not only nominal mean performance
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Industrial parameter/robust design, Taguchi influence, classical factorial/RSM and robust statistics.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Choose designs/settings whose performance remains acceptable as uncontrollable noise factors vary.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A nominal optimum can be fragile to temperature, operator, load, population, supplier or environment.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Local optimisation, high variance, field failure and “best average” designs with poor context tolerance.
properties.MECHANISM: Identify realistic noise factors, cross them with control factors or stress them, model mean/variance/tails separately, and confirm in representative contexts.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Products/processes deployed across variable environments or with costly field failures.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a fixed, tightly controlled environment or a deterministic design margin proven against all relevant variation, elaborate robust DOE may be unnecessary.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Valid noise-factor ranges/distributions, controllable factors, measurement fitness, feasible stress combinations and consequence criteria.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement remains valid across noise conditions and can resolve dispersion/tail changes.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Tested noise factors represent deployment; interactions/model form are adequate; accelerated stresses do not introduce irrelevant mechanisms.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces sensitivity, warranty/failure cost and transfer surprises, often without requiring tighter process control.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reliability/quality engineer and deployment owner.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Over-broad noise arrays can be expensive; robustness to selected factors can hide vulnerability to omitted mechanisms.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Nominal-only optimisation misses field variability and tail risk.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Using Taguchi S/N ratio automatically; unrealistic noise ranges; no confirmation; averaging away context-specific failures.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Using Taguchi S/N ratio automatically; unrealistic noise ranges; no confirmation; averaging away context-specific failures. Contrary evidence/limit: No finite noise-factor set guarantees open-world robustness; field monitoring and conservative design margins remain necessary.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Later statistical criticism retained parameter/noise-factor design but narrowed or replaced universal S/N analyses with direct modelling and standard DOE.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Test and optimise decision-relevant performance across plausible nuisance contexts, with transparent loss and confirmation.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Taguchi orthogonal arrays, S/N ratios and loss slogans are optional/historically contingent; robustness is the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: No finite noise-factor set guarantees open-world robustness; field monitoring and conservative design margins remain necessary.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should robust design cover rare combinations and adversarial contexts without combinatorial explosion?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Select settings/designs that remain acceptable across nuisance contexts.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Independent run/unit at control×noise condition.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Runs independent/blocked; repeated observations nested.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Randomise feasible order; deliberate noise-factor assignment.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Block hard-to-change factors or use split-plot designs.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Independent confirmation across representative noise contexts.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Control×noise interactions are central.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Predefine robustness loss/criteria and confirmation.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Information on sensitivity and variance reduction per run.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Expanded design/stress cost.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Ceremonial S/N optimisation or unrealistic stress matrix.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Direct mean/variance/tail modelling over plausible noise contexts plus confirmation.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Were nuisance/noise factors representative of deployment and crossed with controllable factors?
Is robustness claimed from average performance or from dispersion/tail/context evidence?
Would a direct engineering margin prove robustness more cheaply?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Model reliability over time with explicit failure definitions, exposure, censoring and degradation
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Life-testing, survival analysis, reliability engineering and degradation modelling.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Estimate time-to-failure or degradation processes using all exposure and censoring information under a defined mission/failure criterion.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Snapshot pass rates do not describe reliability duration; censored survivors and varying duty cycles can bias estimates.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Confusing current performance with lifetime reliability, dropping early failures, and ignoring degradation paths.
properties.MECHANISM: Define failure/missions, record time/exposure and interventions, use survival/degradation models with uncertainty, stratify failure modes and validate fit.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Components/systems where ageing, wear, cumulative use or time-dependent failure changes the decision.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a purely timeless deterministic property or rapidly replaceable low-consequence component, full life modelling may not pay.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Representative units/duty cycles, failure-mode taxonomy, censoring records, stable measurement, sufficient time/failures or degradation surrogate.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Failure detection threshold is stable and degradation measure is linked to actual failure.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Independent/appropriately clustered lifetimes, censoring mechanism acceptable, distribution/regression model adequate over prediction horizon.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Supports maintenance, warranty, design margin and release decisions with time-indexed risk.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Reliability engineer, maintainer, design authority and risk owner.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Complex lifetime models can extrapolate far beyond evidence and give false precision; failure definitions may be gamed.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Ignoring time can miss wear-out, early-life or cumulative hazards.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Removing early failures; right-censored units treated as nonfailures forever; mixed modes pooled; uptime denominator changed; threshold drift.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Removing early failures; right-censored units treated as nonfailures forever; mixed modes pooled; uptime denominator changed; threshold drift. Contrary evidence/limit: Complex software/agent failure opportunities may not map cleanly to lifetime distributions; reliability methods transfer only where exposure/failure processes are coherent.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved from failure-count summaries to censored survival, recurrent/repairable systems, covariates, degradation and predictive uncertainty.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Make reliability conditional on mission, time/exposure, failure definition and context; report bounds and model sensitivity.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A Weibull plot or MTBF number is not the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Complex software/agent failure opportunities may not map cleanly to lifetime distributions; reliability methods transfer only where exposure/failure processes are coherent.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should reliability be defined for continually updated systems whose configuration and workload change during exposure?

VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.DECISION_PROBLEM: Predict/monitor failure risk over time and decide maintenance/release.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.ASSUMED_DATA_GENERATING_PROCESS: Time-to-event or degradation process with censoring, covariates and possible competing modes.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Stable failure detection, exposure records and representative duty cycles.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.SIGNAL_OR_DISCRIMINATOR: Hazard/survival/degradation estimate with uncertainty and mode diagnostics.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_POSITIVE_COST: Premature maintenance/rejection.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_NEGATIVE_COST: Unexpected field failure or underestimated wear-out.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.NONSTATIONARITY_RISK: Configuration/context drift can make historical lifetimes obsolete.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.INTERVENTION_RISK: Changing failure threshold or dropping early failures improves apparent reliability.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Deterministic wear limit or conservative life bound when available.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Mission-specific censored/degradation model with sensitivity and ongoing field update.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is the reliability claim tied to a mission, time/exposure and stable failure definition?
Were censored, early and competing-mode observations retained?
Does the model represent deployment duty cycles and configuration changes?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Use accelerated testing only with validated stress-to-use mechanisms and explicit extrapolation uncertainty
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Accelerated life testing, physics-of-failure models and reliability statistics.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Apply elevated stress to obtain failures sooner, then translate to use conditions through an acceleration/life model.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Use-stress tests may produce too few failures, but high stress can create different failure modes or nonlinear extrapolation.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Overstated lifetime, irrelevant stress failures, parameter uncertainty hidden by large acceleration factors.
properties.MECHANISM: Select physically justified stresses, include multiple levels/use-level anchors, diagnose failure modes, fit and challenge acceleration models, report prediction intervals/sensitivity.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Long-lived products where timely direct life testing is infeasible and a credible acceleration mechanism exists.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Do not accelerate when stress changes the mechanism or when conservative deterministic margin/field data already decide the question.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Mechanistic knowledge, representative specimens, stable failure definition, stress control, enough failures/levels and use-condition data/anchors.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Stress/temperature/load measurement is calibrated; failure detection remains comparable across levels.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Same relevant failure mechanisms and adequate acceleration/life distributions across tested-to-use range.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Obtains earlier reliability evidence and supports design comparison without waiting full life.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Reliability/design owner and release/risk authority.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Wrong models can produce orders-of-magnitude false confidence; accelerated stress may damage irrelevant modes.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Avoiding all acceleration can make evidence unavailable before deployment.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: One stress level; no use anchor; pooled failure modes; extrapolation without interval; treating high-stress pass as field proof.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: One stress level; no use anchor; pooled failure modes; extrapolation without interval; treating high-stress pass as field proof. Contrary evidence/limit: Extreme acceleration and sparse failures make model uncertainty dominant; there may be no defensible high-reliability extrapolation.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Mature ALT integrates physics, multiple stresses, model diagnostics and conservative uncertainty rather than a generic acceleration factor.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Acceleration is an assumption-heavy bridge whose physical continuity must be evidenced, not a shortcut to certainty.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A standard Arrhenius/Weibull fit is not the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Extreme acceleration and sparse failures make model uncertainty dominant; there may be no defensible high-reliability extrapolation.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How much use-condition anchoring is enough to falsify an acceleration model before release?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Estimate use-condition life from elevated-stress tests.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Independent specimen/system at a stress level.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Lifetimes independent/clustered; censoring and common batch effects modelled.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Randomise specimens/run order where feasible; stress deliberately assigned.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Block batch/manufacturing lot and include use-level anchors.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Independent specimens across multiple stress levels and confirmation.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Stress×failure-mode/material interactions can invalidate extrapolation.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Predefine censoring/test termination and model-selection/validation rule.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Large time acceleration if model is valid.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Specimens, chambers, destructive failures and model risk.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Routine ALT without physics or anchors creates false certainty.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Physics-informed multi-level ALT with failure-mode checks, sensitivity and conservative prediction.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: What physical evidence shows the accelerated and use conditions share failure mechanisms?
How far beyond observed stress/time is the reliability claim extrapolated?
Would a conservative design bound or degradation measure be more credible?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Treat reliability growth as intervention-conditioned evidence, not an automatically improving trend
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Reliability growth testing, Crow–AMSAA/Duane-type models and test-analyse-fix programmes.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Evaluate whether documented design/process fixes change failure intensity over exposure while accounting for configuration and environment.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A downward failure trend can arise from easier tests, survivor populations, changed definitions or selective fixes rather than durable growth.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Trend worship, double-counting fixes, uncontrolled configuration changes and claiming causality from calendar order.
properties.MECHANISM: Version configurations, log every intervention/exposure/failure mode, use growth models as summaries, and validate fixes on fresh representative tests/field data.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Development programmes with repeated failures and deliberate corrective modifications.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: When no modifications occur, use ordinary reliability estimation; when one deterministic defect/fix is proven, validate that mechanism directly.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Configuration control, comparable exposure/test environments, stable failure definitions, independent validation and enough events.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement/evaluator thresholds are stable across versions or bridged.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Model form approximates the repair/improvement process; changes other than intended fixes are documented.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Turns failures into structured learning and supports readiness forecasts.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Reliability programme manager, design authority and acquisition/release decision maker.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Growth targets can incentivise relabelling failures or easier tests; fitted curves can extrapolate beyond fix effectiveness.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: No growth tracking loses cumulative learning and repeated-mode evidence.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Test difficulty decreases; failures reclassified; exposure resets; fixes not independently verified; one programme curve pooled across modes.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Test difficulty decreases; failures reclassified; exposure resets; fixes not independently verified; one programme curve pooled across modes. Contrary evidence/limit: Growth models are particularly vulnerable when few failures, many simultaneous changes or rapidly changing test environments exist.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Consensus guidance narrows claims and stresses configuration/test-environment assumptions and independent verification.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Attribute change to documented fixes only when comparable exposure and fresh validation support it; otherwise call it an observed trend.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A Crow–AMSAA plot or target slope is not the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Growth models are particularly vulnerable when few failures, many simultaneous changes or rapidly changing test environments exist.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can causal contribution be allocated among bundled fixes without an infeasible factorial programme?

VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.DECISION_PROBLEM: Decide whether reliability is improving after interventions and whether readiness targets are credible.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.ASSUMED_DATA_GENERATING_PROCESS: Failure process over exposure with discrete design/process interventions and configuration changes.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Stable failure definitions, exposure accounting and versioned configurations.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.SIGNAL_OR_DISCRIMINATOR: Mode-specific post-fix reduction confirmed under comparable/fresh tests.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_POSITIVE_COST: Credit to ineffective fixes and premature release.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_NEGATIVE_COST: Failure to recognise genuine learning or recurring modes.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.NONSTATIONARITY_RISK: Test environment and configuration changes are major nonstationarity.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.INTERVENTION_RISK: Relabelling or easier testing can manufacture growth.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Direct proof/validation of a specific deterministic fix.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Intervention-conditioned trend plus fresh validation and configuration control.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Are reliability improvements tied to documented fixes and comparable exposure?
Did failure definitions, thresholds, test difficulty or configuration change?
Was the claimed fix validated on fresh representative units?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Translate zero observed failures into an upper risk bound, never “perfect reliability”
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Binomial/Poisson reliability demonstration and the rule of three.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use one-sided confidence/credible bounds on failure probability/rate when no events are observed.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Zero events in finite exposure is compatible with nonzero—sometimes material—failure rates.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Infinite-reliability claims, misleading “100% pass,” and underpowered high-reliability demonstrations.
properties.MECHANISM: Define independent opportunities/exposure and target confidence; calculate bound, include heterogeneity/censoring, and compare with required risk.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Reliability/safety claims based on zero failures or no detected rare defects.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: When a formal proof/physical impossibility establishes zero risk within scope, statistical zero-event bounds are secondary; verify proof scope.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Clear failure opportunity, independent/representative trials, stable detection threshold, complete event capture and fixed stopping.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Failures would be detected with sufficient sensitivity; no excluded/censored near-failures.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Bernoulli/Poisson/exposure model and homogeneity or conservative stratification are adequate.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Converts “none seen” into a transparent finite statement and reveals sample burden for high reliability.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Safety/reliability/release authority and customer/regulator.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Bounds can be overly reassuring if opportunities are correlated/easy or detection misses failures; conservative bounds may require huge samples.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Ignoring zero-event uncertainty can understate tail risk by orders of magnitude.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Counting repeated same-condition trials as independent; optional stopping after a clean run; changing failure definition; hiding near misses.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Counting repeated same-condition trials as independent; optional stopping after a clean run; changing failure definition; hiding near misses. Contrary evidence/limit: Extremely low target rates are rarely demonstrable by direct testing alone; model/mechanism/operational evidence must be combined without pretending equivalence.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Modern practice uses exact/Bayesian/Poisson/exposure bounds and combines test with mechanistic/field evidence for very high reliability.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Report the strongest upper bound supported by independent representative exposure and state what remains unobserved.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: “0 defects” and a green dashboard are not properties.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Extremely low target rates are rarely demonstrable by direct testing alone; model/mechanism/operational evidence must be combined without pretending equivalence.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should heterogeneous stress, common-mode failures and changing exposure be incorporated into zero-event bounds?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Demonstrate that failure probability/rate is below an engineering bound.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Independent unit/opportunity or exposure interval.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Independence/common-mode assumptions explicitly tested or conservatively adjusted.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Random sampling of units/conditions where possible.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Stratify high-risk contexts and common-mode clusters.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Independent opportunities; repeats on one unit may not count equally.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Context interactions can concentrate rare failures.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Fixed exposure/sample or valid sequential reliability-demonstration plan.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Tightens upper risk bound.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Large sample/exposure burden, especially for rare targets.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Massive low-risk testing can crowd out mechanism/stress evidence.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Bound-based demonstration integrated with mechanistic and stress evidence.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: What upper failure-rate bound—not pass percentage—follows from the independent exposure?
Are trials representative and sufficiently sensitive to detect failure?
Could correlation, optional stopping or changed definitions make zero failures uninformative?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Treat rare-event and tail claims as distinct, data-hungry and model-sensitive
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Extreme-value/tolerance/reliability theory, rare-event sampling and safety/reliability practice.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Analyse high quantiles, exceedance probabilities and catastrophic modes separately from means and ordinary variance.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Good averages and even stable central behaviour can coexist with unacceptable tails; finite data contain little direct tail information.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Rare-event overconfidence, normal extrapolation, benchmark averages hiding catastrophic cases and absence-of-event fallacy.
properties.MECHANISM: Define tail event/consequence, preserve maxima/near misses, use tolerance/extreme/reliability models with diagnostics and conservative bounds, stress/importance sample, and combine mechanism evidence.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: High-consequence low-frequency failures, tight population-content guarantees or asymmetric loss.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For bounded deterministic systems with proven hard limits, direct worst-case analysis can dominate statistical tail estimation.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable event definition/detection, representative exposure including stress contexts, enough tail observations or justified physical model, and no selective deletion.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Resolution captures near-tail behaviour and censoring/thresholds are stable.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Tail family/extrapolation and dependence are adequate; stress sampling is correctly reweighted; unobserved modes acknowledged.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Prevents mean-focused release and quantifies what high reliability cannot be claimed from limited evidence.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Safety/reliability/design authority and risk owner.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Tail models can be highly unstable and stress tests can create irrelevant modes; extreme conservatism can make decisions impossible.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Ignoring tails can hide catastrophic but decision-dominating outcomes.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Normal six-sigma extrapolation; dropping outliers; zero events called zero risk; tail metric tuned after incident; pooled modes.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Normal six-sigma extrapolation; dropping outliers; zero events called zero risk; tail metric tuned after incident; pooled modes. Contrary evidence/limit: Unknown failure modes and dependence can dominate beyond-sample tails; precise numerical estimates may be less honest than conservative bounds/scenarios.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved toward explicit tolerance/exceedance bounds, extreme-value methods, stress testing and mechanism-informed conservative evidence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Separate central performance from tail claims; calibrate claim strength to observed/validated tail information and consequence.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A “six sigma” label or one worst-case anecdote is not the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Unknown failure modes and dependence can dominate beyond-sample tails; precise numerical estimates may be less honest than conservative bounds/scenarios.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What combination of stress, mechanism and operational data justifies a claim at a failure rate never directly observed?

VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.DECISION_PROBLEM: Detect/limit rare catastrophic events or high quantiles.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.ASSUMED_DATA_GENERATING_PROCESS: Heavy-tail/extreme/event process with possible dependence and heterogeneous exposure.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Sensitive event capture, exposure denominator and preserved extremes/near misses.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.SIGNAL_OR_DISCRIMINATOR: Conservative exceedance/tolerance bound or stress-validated mechanism.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_POSITIVE_COST: False alarms/overdesign from unstable tails.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_NEGATIVE_COST: Catastrophic missed mode or grossly understated rate.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.NONSTATIONARITY_RISK: Tail law and exposure can shift strongly.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.INTERVENTION_RISK: Dropping “outliers” or changing event definitions erases risk.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Deterministic worst-case bound/interlock if authoritative.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Multi-source conservative tail case with explicit evidence limit.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is a mean or central interval being used to imply tail safety?
How much direct or validated stress/mechanism evidence exists for the claimed tail?
Were outliers, near misses and censored failures preserved?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Test distribution shift and stress contexts; do not equate held-out performance with deployment validity
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Measurement invariance, robust/reliability testing, dataset-shift science and refreshed benchmark evidence.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Evaluate whether performance/calibration persists under plausible population, environment, workload, adversarial or temporal shifts.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A model/process can succeed on a fixed holdout while failing after deployment composition, context or incentives change.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Benchmark saturation, test-set overfitting, stale controls and false generalisation from one distribution.
properties.MECHANISM: Map shift scenarios, reserve protected/refresh samples, stress test mechanism-relevant changes, monitor calibration and restrict claims to covered regions.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Adaptive software/ML/agent systems, long-lived processes, changing customers/suppliers, or field environments beyond lab conditions.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a closed deterministic domain fully enumerated by an authoritative test, distribution-shift analysis may be unnecessary; verify closure.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Context metadata, representative or deliberately stressed samples, stable evaluator/construct, fresh data source and shift-response plan.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Labels/references remain valid under shift or are independently adjudicated.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Stress scenarios are plausible and not merely convenient; deployment monitoring can detect uncovered shifts.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Finds brittle improvements before deployment and makes holdout evidence scope honest.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Deployment owner, reliability/quality engineer and benchmark/evaluator owner.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Stress suites can overfit too, invent unrealistic cases or create endless scenario bureaucracy.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Single-distribution evaluation can produce sharp but stale confidence.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Repeated public benchmark tuning; no fresh collection; adversarial examples counted as prevalence; aggregate shift hides subgroup collapse.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Repeated public benchmark tuning; no fresh collection; adversarial examples counted as prevalence; aggregate shift hides subgroup collapse. Contrary evidence/limit: Open-world shifts are unbounded; no finite suite proves universal robustness, and fresh sets may still share collection artefacts.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Modern practice combines protected holdouts, fresh test sets, shift taxonomy, stress scenarios and ongoing field monitoring.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A held-out score is local evidence; deployment claims require context coverage, shift sensitivity and evaluator integrity.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A benchmark leaderboard or one stress suite is not the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Open-world shifts are unbounded; no finite suite proves universal robustness, and fresh sets may still share collection artefacts.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should shift suites be refreshed independently without making longitudinal progress incomparable?

VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.DECISION_PROBLEM: Detect performance/calibration degradation under changing deployment distributions.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.ASSUMED_DATA_GENERATING_PROCESS: Context-indexed data distribution with possible covariate, prior, concept and adversarial shifts.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Fresh/protected samples, stable labels/evaluator and context metadata.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.SIGNAL_OR_DISCRIMINATOR: Shift-sensitive calibration/performance deviation tied to action.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_POSITIVE_COST: Chasing unrealistic stress cases or alarm fatigue.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_NEGATIVE_COST: Deployment failure outside the original holdout.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.NONSTATIONARITY_RISK: Defining risk; historical guarantees are local.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.INTERVENTION_RISK: Refreshing/tuning on failures can absorb evidence.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Closed-domain exhaustive check or targeted mechanism test.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Protected fresh evaluation plus scenario stress and field drift monitoring.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does held-out evidence cover deployment populations, contexts and incentives?
Could benchmark/test-set reuse or contamination explain the score?
What shift would invalidate the current threshold or evaluator calibration?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Keep mean performance, variability, tail behaviour, reliability over time and model robustness as separate claims
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Quality variation, robust design, tolerance/reliability theory and modern multi-metric evaluation.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Decompose performance dimensions instead of compressing them into one average or sigma score.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: An improvement in mean can worsen variability, tails, durability or context sensitivity; a composite can hide the trade.
