properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: False “overall improvement,” weighted-metric gaming and releases that optimise average at the expense of catastrophic modes.
properties.MECHANISM: Report decision-relevant central effect, dispersion, quantiles/tails, time/exposure reliability and assumption/context sensitivity separately; use explicit multi-criteria decisions.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Systems with heterogeneous outcomes, repeated operation, rare harms or multiple stakeholders.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a single exact binary requirement with no temporal/context dimension, one authoritative result may be sufficient.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Valid metrics for each dimension, declared weighting/priority, representative units/contexts and enough tail/time evidence for any claim.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement error is separated by dimension and thresholds remain stable.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Dimensions are not falsely treated as independent; composite utility, if used, is explicit and decision-owned.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Prevents one favourable summary from erasing reliability or tail regressions.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Design/release authority, risk owner and public evidence consumer.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Too many dimensions create multiplicity and indecision; dashboards can become ritual without priorities.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: One-score optimisation can hide exactly the failure mode that matters most.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Mean-only benchmark; variance ignored; uptime without severity; composite weights changed; tail based on one anecdote.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Mean-only benchmark; variance ignored; uptime without severity; composite weights changed; tail based on one anecdote. Contrary evidence/limit: Multi-criteria trade-offs are partly normative and may resist statistical aggregation; unresolved conflicts must remain visible.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved from mean/variance quality metrics toward explicit reliability, robustness, tails and context-separated evidence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Make one claim per dimension and combine them only through a transparent consequence model.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A mandatory giant dashboard is not the property; non-substitution among materially different risk dimensions is.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Multi-criteria trade-offs are partly normative and may resist statistical aggregation; unresolved conflicts must remain visible.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What minimal dimension set prevents harmful substitution without producing unmanageable reporting?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Are mean, variability, tail, time reliability and context robustness being claimed separately?
Could a favourable average conceal a serious tail or durability regression?
Who owns any composite weighting, and was it frozen before results?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Treat optimised metrics as vulnerable proxies and monitor for gaming/surrogation
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Goodhart/Campbell/Strathern indicator criticism, quality-target experience and modern benchmark overfitting.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Assume a metric’s relation to the underlying goal can weaken when rewards, release or status depend on it.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Optimisers learn to improve the measurement surface rather than the real property.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Relabelled defects, denominator shifts, benchmark overfitting, threshold gaming and local metric improvement with system harm.
properties.MECHANISM: Keep construct/outcome checks independent, use multiple non-substitutable indicators where justified, audit exclusions/denominators, refresh protected evidence and inspect mechanisms.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: High-stakes target metrics, leaderboards, incentives, automated optimisation or repeated candidate exposure.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a direct authoritative physical/logical property that cannot be cheaply manipulated, proxy safeguards may be minimal; maintain authority/integrity checks.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined underlying goal, provenance, stable denominators, independent outcome/reference evidence and the ability to observe optimisation response.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Metric and construct are distinguishable; evaluator changes and candidate exposures are versioned.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: A plausible behavioural/optimisation mechanism links targeting to metric degradation; independent checks are not co-optimised.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Prevents numerical improvement from substituting for real engineering improvement.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Metric owner, incentive/release authority and system outcome owner.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Anti-gaming controls can become adversarial bureaucracy, suppress useful optimisation or proliferate unowned metrics.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Ignoring gaming allows precise, reproducible and meaningless success.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Dropping hard cases; changing denominator; teaching to test; benchmark leakage; proxy chosen for availability; outcome not independently checked.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Dropping hard cases; changing denominator; teaching to test; benchmark leakage; proxy chosen for availability; outcome not independently checked. Contrary evidence/limit: Goodhart/Campbell claims are not universal formal theorems; some metrics remain useful under targeting if causal alignment and integrity controls are strong.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: The social-science laws are treated as convergent warning mechanisms, strengthened in digital domains by adaptive-data/benchmark evidence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use metrics as defeasible sensors: preserve an independent construct/outcome path and investigate divergence under optimisation.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: “Use multiple KPIs” is not itself the property; independent construct evidence and anti-substitution boundaries are.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Goodhart/Campbell claims are not universal formal theorems; some metrics remain useful under targeting if causal alignment and integrity controls are strong.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can independent outcome checks remain independent when the whole organisation can observe and optimise them?

VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.DECISION_PROBLEM: Detect divergence between a governed metric and the underlying system outcome.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.ASSUMED_DATA_GENERATING_PROCESS: Metric and latent goal co-evolve under optimisation/incentives.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Independent outcome/reference measures, provenance and stable definitions.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.SIGNAL_OR_DISCRIMINATOR: Metric–outcome divergence, exclusion/denominator anomalies or mechanism failure.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_POSITIVE_COST: False accusations of gaming and metric churn.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_NEGATIVE_COST: Sustained optimisation of a corrupted proxy.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.NONSTATIONARITY_RISK: Very high because optimisation changes behaviour/data.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.INTERVENTION_RISK: Changing the metric after each exploitation can create evaluator instability.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Direct outcome/mechanism check when cheap.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Protected independent checks, versioning and controlled metric retirement.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Can the target metric be improved without improving the underlying engineering property?
Have denominators, labels, exclusions or case mix changed under incentive?
What independent outcome or mechanism evidence would expose proxy capture?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Require independent, prospective justification before changing an evaluator, fixture, expected answer or threshold after failure
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Measurement assurance/calibration change control, conformity decision rules, adaptive-data safeguards and proxy-gaming criticism.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Treat post-failure evaluator change as a new measurement intervention needing evidence independent of the candidate outcome.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: An organisation can make failures disappear by editing the instrument rather than fixing the object.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Evaluator drift, threshold drift, moving goalposts and reward hacking disguised as recalibration.
properties.MECHANISM: Classify suspected defect (candidate/measurement/construct/sampling), reproduce on references, use blinded bridge studies, obtain independent authority, version change and re-evaluate affected claims.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Any proposed evaluator/threshold/fixture/answer change triggered by an unfavourable result.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Correct a provable transcription/specification error immediately, preserving evidence and authority; no large statistical study is needed.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Frozen prior version, external reference/construct evidence, bridge sample, change rationale and authority separate from candidate optimisation.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Reference cases include failures/boundaries and are protected from the candidate change.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: The bridge can distinguish measurement defect from candidate defect; updated rule better represents the underlying construct.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Allows legitimate recalibration while blocking outcome-contingent mutation.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Measurement/evaluator owner, release authority and independent reviewer.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Excessive governance can freeze known-bad evaluators or delay urgent safety corrections.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Weak governance permits arbitrary pass-making and destroys longitudinal evidence.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Changing expected output after seeing candidate; threshold chosen to include current score; deleting failed case; no old/new bridge; circular validation.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Changing expected output after seeing candidate; threshold chosen to include current score; deleting failed case; no old/new bridge; circular validation. Contrary evidence/limit: Independent reference truth may be unavailable for evolving constructs; legitimate change can remain unresolved rather than forced.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved from calibration/check-standard discipline to versioned benchmark/evaluator governance and reusable-holdout independence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Change only on independent evidence that the measurement/construct—not merely the candidate—is defective or context has legitimately changed.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A fixed change-request form is optional; independence, bridge and retrospective impact assessment are the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Independent reference truth may be unavailable for evolving constructs; legitimate change can remain unresolved rather than forced.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Who can supply independent construct authority when the evaluator and target system co-evolve?

VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.DECISION_PROBLEM: Decide whether an apparent failure warrants candidate correction or evaluator recalibration.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.ASSUMED_DATA_GENERATING_PROCESS: Candidate state and evaluator state both potentially vary; reference bridge observes both versions.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Frozen versions, protected reference cases and independent adjudication.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.SIGNAL_OR_DISCRIMINATOR: Reference-based evidence that old evaluator is biased/invalid and new one improves construct fidelity.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_POSITIVE_COST: Freezing a defective evaluator or false recalibration alarm.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_NEGATIVE_COST: Outcome-contingent evaluator mutation that converts failure to pass.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.NONSTATIONARITY_RISK: Context/construct change may legitimately require revision.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.INTERVENTION_RISK: Core risk: threshold/answer movement after seeing failure.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Fix an authoritative clerical/specification error with documented source.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Independent prospective bridge, versioning and retrospective impact review.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Was the evaluator/threshold change proposed only after a candidate failed?
What evidence independent of that candidate shows a measurement or construct defect?
Is there a blinded old/new bridge and an assessment of affected prior conclusions?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Separate candidate/process variation from evaluator/measurement variation before assigning corrective action
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Measurement-system analysis, method agreement, measurement-error effects on control/experiments and evaluator drift governance.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use crossed/replicated reference and candidate observations to locate variation source before changing either side.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A changed score alone cannot identify whether candidate, evaluator, fixture, environment or sample changed.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Fixing the wrong component, circular debugging and endless candidate/evaluator oscillation.
properties.MECHANISM: Maintain reference cases and stable candidates, cross evaluators/versions/operators, decompose variation and test specific mechanism hypotheses.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Unexpected regression/improvement, disagreement across evaluators, near-threshold failures or repeated nonreproducibility.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: If a direct inspection proves a deterministic candidate defect or evaluator bug, repair that source immediately and document it.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable reference/candidate artefacts, versioned evaluators, repeat/cross-over design and protected provenance.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement runs are comparable; reference cases cover the disputed region.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Variance components/interactions are estimable enough to discriminate source or else conclusion remains unresolved.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Targets corrective work, preserves evidence and reduces blame/proxy mutation.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Engineer, measurement owner and independent review authority.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Formal decomposition can be expensive and ambiguous when both candidate and evaluator adapt; variance attribution is not causal proof by itself.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: No separation makes every failure negotiable and every improvement suspect.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Only rerunning candidate; only checking easy references; evaluator and candidate changed together; no interaction analysis; regression to mean.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Only rerunning candidate; only checking easy references; evaluator and candidate changed together; no interaction analysis; regression to mean. Contrary evidence/limit: Variance decomposition can identify where variability resides but not automatically which construct is correct or why the interaction occurs.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved from physical gauge R&R to general crossed evaluator/candidate/reference designs and configuration bridges.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Hold one side fixed while testing the other against independent references; leave unresolved when evidence cannot distinguish.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A GR&R percentage is not required; discriminating source of variation is the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Variance decomposition can identify where variability resides but not automatically which construct is correct or why the interaction occurs.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should source discrimination proceed when the evaluator is learned from candidate-generated data?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Discriminate whether a changed result arises from candidate, evaluator or their interaction.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Candidate/reference item crossed with evaluator/version/condition.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Repeated observations nested; independent items required for generalisation.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Randomise/blind order and candidate identity.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Block time/environment and preserve bridge overlap.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Multiple stable items and independently executed evaluator runs.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Candidate×evaluator interaction is often the decisive finding.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Predefine suspected-source comparisons; do not stop at first favourable rerun.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Directs corrective action to the varying component.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Reference construction and crossed reruns.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Full crossing can be expensive or impossible for destructive systems.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Smallest crossed/bridge design that separates source, with unresolved outcome if not identifiable.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Before changing the candidate, what evidence shows the evaluator is stable and valid?
Before changing the evaluator, what evidence shows stable references are mismeasured?
Were candidate and evaluator ever varied independently in a crossed design?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Protect holdouts, reproduce analyses and prevent adaptive evaluation reuse from masquerading as fresh evidence
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Reproducible statistical analysis, multiple testing, reusable holdouts and modern benchmark-refresh evidence.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Keep confirmation data/evaluators sufficiently independent of adaptive development and make the full analysis executable/reviewable.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Repeated tuning on a holdout leaks information; rerunning the same pipeline is reproducibility, not independent validation.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Benchmark saturation, test contamination, hidden analyst flexibility and false replication.
properties.MECHANISM: Separate development/exploration/confirmation, restrict feedback, log access, use reusable-holdout methods where applicable, refresh externally and reproduce exact computation.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Iterative software/ML/agent development, repeated benchmark submissions, many model/analysis variants or long campaigns.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a deterministic exhaustive authoritative test, repeated execution may verify implementation but does not need a statistical holdout.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Versioned data/code/evaluator, access/provenance controls, representative fresh samples and a defined confirmation claim.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Evaluation pipeline itself is stable/validated; contamination/duplication detectable.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Protected sample remains sufficiently independent; reusable-holdout privacy/model conditions or fresh-data assumptions hold.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Preserves an honest out-of-sample error estimate and separates computational reproducibility from evidential independence.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Developer, benchmark owner, reviewer and deployment authority.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Strict secrecy can reduce debugging/transparency; fresh sets may introduce shift and break comparability.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Unprotected reuse makes apparent progress partly a property of evaluator exposure.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Calling same holdout reruns “replications”; public test labels; leaderboard tuning; analysis not executable; fresh test collected differently.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Calling same holdout reruns “replications”; public test labels; leaderboard tuning; analysis not executable; fresh test collected differently. Contrary evidence/limit: Fresh data can differ for reasons unrelated to overfitting; holdout protection trades off feedback, shift and sample efficiency.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved from train/test splitting toward adaptive-data safeguards, access accounting, refreshed benchmarks and reproducibility packages.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: State what was reused, what was protected, and what evidence is genuinely fresh; use independent confirmation for final claims.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A fixed split percentage or preregistration badge is not the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Fresh data can differ for reasons unrelated to overfitting; holdout protection trades off feedback, shift and sample efficiency.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can adaptive systems receive useful diagnostic feedback while preserving independent final evaluation?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Confirm generalisation after adaptive development/analysis.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Fresh independently sampled evaluation unit.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Shared source/duplicates and repeated holdout use induce dependence.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Treatment randomisation if causal; data access control for predictive confirmation.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Stratify fresh set by decision-relevant contexts.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Independent fresh units/datasets, not resampling the exposed holdout.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Performance may interact with collection/context shift.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Predefine final access/look or use valid reusable-holdout protocol.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Unbiased/controlled confirmation after adaptivity.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Fresh data, secrecy/access governance and reproducible pipeline.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Excessive holdout fragmentation or no debugging signal.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Transparent reuse accounting plus protected/fresh confirmation and shift analysis.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Which results come from fresh protected evidence rather than evaluator reuse?
Does exact computational reproduction add independent information or only verify execution?
Has test-set access, contamination and feedback been audited?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Check model adequacy and misspecification against the decision, not through ritual assumption tests
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Residual diagnostics, Box model criticism, robust statistics, time-series/SPC and modern predictive checking.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Ask whether model errors materially affect the action, using residual structure, calibration, predictive checks and sensitivity.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Mathematical validity under assumptions is mistaken for evidence those assumptions hold; normality-test rituals can reject harmless deviations or miss dependence.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Invalid intervals/control limits/extrapolations and false confidence in a convenient fitted model.
properties.MECHANISM: Inspect time/order/residual/influence/calibration plots, compare plausible models, simulate operating characteristics and use robust/design-based alternatives where needed.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Any inferential/control/reliability method whose operating characteristics depend materially on distribution, independence, link or functional form.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For deterministic checks or methods robust by design to the relevant deviation, skip irrelevant normality tests and document why.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Adequate data over intended region, stable measurement, model purpose and known decision-sensitive assumptions.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement artefacts/censoring/rounding are modelled or ruled out before diagnosing process distribution.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Diagnostics have power for material deviations; alternative models are plausible and not chosen only for desired results.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Prevents assumption decorations from legitimising fragile decisions and focuses remediation on consequential departures.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Analyst, monitoring/experiment owner and reviewer.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: With small samples diagnostics have low power; with huge samples they detect trivial deviations; repeated model search adds multiplicity.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: No adequacy check can make nominal guarantees badly wrong.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Mandatory Shapiro–Wilk; accepting model because p>.05; residuals not time-ordered; transformation after seeing desired significance; no out-of-sample check.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Mandatory Shapiro–Wilk; accepting model because p>.05; residuals not time-ordered; transformation after seeing desired significance; no out-of-sample check. Contrary evidence/limit: Model adequacy is never globally established; it is conditional on data region and purpose, and diagnostics can share blind spots.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved from pass/fail assumption tests to graphical/predictive/sensitivity assessment of decision consequences.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use the simplest adequate model and report which guarantees are conditional; switch/robustify when a departure changes the decision.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A normality test checklist is ceremony; decision-sensitive adequacy is the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Model adequacy is never globally established; it is conditional on data region and purpose, and diagnostics can share blind spots.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should model uncertainty be communicated when several models are adequate centrally but diverge in the decision tail?

VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.DECISION_PROBLEM: Validate the model used to set limits, detect shifts or predict capability.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.ASSUMED_DATA_GENERATING_PROCESS: Proposed probabilistic/dynamic model versus observed residual/predictive structure.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Stable measurements, time/order and enough baseline coverage.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.SIGNAL_OR_DISCRIMINATOR: Decision-relevant lack-of-fit, calibration or operating-characteristic failure.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_POSITIVE_COST: Discarding a useful simple model for trivial deviations.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_NEGATIVE_COST: Using invalid limits/predictions under material misspecification.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.NONSTATIONARITY_RISK: Model adequacy can expire as process/context shifts.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.INTERVENTION_RISK: Refitting until alarms vanish can absorb real change.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Use distribution-free/direct limits or mechanism-based discriminator.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Purpose-specific model checks, sensitivity and versioned refit governance.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Which assumption could materially change the decision?
Were diagnostics matched to time, dependence, tails and prediction—not only normality?
Is a robust or deterministic alternative available that avoids the fragile assumption?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Integrate multiple statistical and engineering methods into a system-level evidence strategy
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Quality planning/control traditions, Steiner–MacKay variation reduction and Hoerl–Snee/ISEA statistical engineering.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Structure large, complex, unstructured problems; sequence measurement, process, experiment, reliability and decision tools around a mission.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A toolkit used piecemeal can optimise local metrics, repeat work, miss dependencies or apply the right method at the wrong time.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Cookbook statistics, tool proliferation, local optimisation and unresolved interfaces between measurement, experimentation and action.
properties.MECHANISM: Define mission/system, map evidence dependencies, identify dominant uncertainty, select/integrate the smallest valid methods, iterate with governance and sustain the solution.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Cross-disciplinary problems too large for one model/test and with multiple linked decisions.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a well-structured local question solved by one authoritative method/check, use that method; system-level statistical engineering would be overhead.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Decision authority, cross-disciplinary domain knowledge, measurement integrity, provenance, resource model and explicit interfaces among methods.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Every input measurement/evaluator has sufficient fitness and common identities/units are maintained.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Integration logic is auditable; no method’s assumptions are silently contradicted by another stage; organisational cooperation exists.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Converts statistics from a menu into an evidence-efficient engineering system and improves sustainability/transfer of solutions.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: System/problem owner, cross-functional engineering team and decision governance.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: The emerging discipline can become branding, consultant theatre or an unfalsifiable “use the right tools” slogan; causal programme evidence is limited.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Single-tool thinking misses coupled measurement/process/decision failures.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Framework phases treated as deliverables; tool count mistaken for rigour; no dominant uncertainty; local Cpk improvement harms system outcome.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Framework phases treated as deliverables; tool count mistaken for rigour; no dominant uncertainty; local Cpk improvement harms system outcome. Contrary evidence/limit: Evidence is strong for component methods and plausible for integration, but weak for a unique discipline-wide causal effect independent of competent engineering management.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Broader statistical engineering generalises beyond a 2005 manufacturing algorithm and beyond Six Sigma, but remains an emerging discipline with case-heavy evidence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A problem-structuring and integration property: right evidence, right order, right scale, with assumptions and consumer decisions explicit.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The label, framework diagram or consultancy is not the property; integration and sustainable decision improvement are.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Evidence is strong for component methods and plausible for integration, but weak for a unique discipline-wide causal effect independent of competent engineering management.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which integration patterns are distinctively statistical engineering rather than good systems engineering with statistics?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: Sequence a portfolio of experiments/measurements to resolve a complex system decision.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: Varies by subproblem; integration must preserve each true experimental unit.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: Cross-study dependence/common data and shared evaluators must be represented.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Use randomisation where causal; do not force it on deterministic subproblems.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: Coordinate blocking/stratification across relevant interfaces.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Independent confirmation at system-critical claims, not repeated local analyses.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Cross-component interactions and local-to-system trade-offs are central.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Mission-level stopping based on remaining decision uncertainty/value.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Reduces dominant uncertainty across the whole problem.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: Coordination, data integration and cross-disciplinary time.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Framework bureaucracy or endless decomposition.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Lean problem architecture with explicit evidence dependencies and local method cheap paths.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target problem require several evidence methods whose dependencies must be engineered?
Is the dominant uncertainty identified before selecting tools?
Could a single local method or deterministic check solve the decision more cheaply?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Make measurement and controls economically proportional; retire, revalidate or recalibrate stale controls
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Shewhart/Duncan economic control, value-of-information reasoning, calibration intervals and modern monitoring governance.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Maintain evidence only while it changes decisions at acceptable cost; reassess controls when process, risk, measurement or cheaper discriminators change.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Legacy dashboards/tests continue by habit, creating noise and cost; obsolete thresholds can govern a changed system.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Measurement debt, stale controls, alert fatigue, audit theatre and resources diverted from higher-value evidence.
properties.MECHANISM: Track each control’s decision consumer, failure mode, operating characteristics, cost and last validation; trigger retirement/recalibration when value or validity decays.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Long-lived quality systems, recurring tests, duplicated reviews, low-yield monitoring or changed process/evaluator context.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Keep cheap high-value controls and legal/safety requirements even if failures are rare; deterministic checks may remain near-zero cost.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Control inventory/ownership, event/decision history, cost, process/evaluator version, replacement/retirement authority and risk constraints.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Control outcomes and false alarms/misses are measurable enough to assess utility; reference standards remain available.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Past yield predicts some future value or scenario analysis captures uncertainty; retirement does not violate unmodelled catastrophic safeguards.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces evidence burden, prevents stale governance and reallocates effort to decisive measurements.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Control owner, risk authority, resource allocator and downstream consumer.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Retiring a quiet control can remove defence against rare catastrophe; cost pressure can bias value estimates.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Never reviewing controls accumulates brittle, gamed and contradictory gates.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Quota retained with no consumer; threshold never revalidated; duplicated tests treated as corroboration; control removed because it catches failures.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Quota retained with no consumer; threshold never revalidated; duplicated tests treated as corroboration; control removed because it catches failures. Contrary evidence/limit: Rare-event controls may have high option value despite little observed use; absence of catches is not sufficient retirement evidence.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved from economic chart design to lifecycle governance across measurements, experiments, thresholds and benchmark controls.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Every recurring control has a current decision, validity evidence and proportional cost; otherwise simplify, replace, revalidate or retire with risk sign-off.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A periodic review ceremony is not the property unless it can actually retire/change controls on evidence.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Rare-event controls may have high option value despite little observed use; absence of catches is not sufficient retirement evidence.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can stale-control retirement be distinguished from gaming away inconvenient evidence?

VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.DECISION_PROBLEM: Retain, tune, replace or retire a recurring control.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.ASSUMED_DATA_GENERATING_PROCESS: Control outcomes and underlying risk/process evolve over time.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Usage/decision/false-alarm records and current reference validation.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.SIGNAL_OR_DISCRIMINATOR: Positive net decision value and valid calibration for present context.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_POSITIVE_COST: Ongoing cost, alert fatigue and tampering.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_NEGATIVE_COST: Loss of early warning or rare-event defence.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.NONSTATIONARITY_RISK: Core: process/evaluator/risk drift makes controls stale.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.INTERVENTION_RISK: Retirement after inconvenient failures can be proxy gaming.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Retain a cheap deterministic check or consolidate duplicates.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Lifecycle evidence review with independent retirement authority and risk bounds.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: What current decision does each recurring measurement/control change?
When was its measurement validity and threshold last challenged against current context?
Would retirement remove rare-event defence or merely ceremony?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Universal p < 0.05 threshold as an engineering decision rule
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Later textbook/journal/managerial simplification of significance testing, not a property asserted by Fisher or Neyman–Pearson as a universal engineering rule.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Dichotomise results at a conventional significance threshold and treat crossing it as sufficient for action or truth.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Originally offered a convenient convention, but it fails to encode effect size, measurement validity, multiplicity, model adequacy or decision loss.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Bright-line publication/release decisions, p-hacking, trivial effects called important and non-significant results called equivalent.
properties.MECHANISM: No defensible general mechanism; replace with decision/effect/uncertainty design and use p-values only as one calibrated diagnostic where appropriate.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: No universal trigger. A predeclared alpha can be useful inside a specific confirmatory error-control design.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For deterministic checks, descriptive estimation, Bayesian/decision designs, equivalence or safety constraints, the convention may be irrelevant.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: If used: valid model/design, prespecified family/stopping, effect/margin and consequence-aware threshold.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement and sampling validity must already hold.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: The test statistic/reference model and error family are correct; the chosen alpha reflects decision consequences—which 0.05 usually does not by default.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Within a valid design, a threshold can standardise one error rate; the universal convention offers no general engineering payoff.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Specific confirmatory protocol owner, not general management branding.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: False dichotomy, threshold gaming and loss of uncertainty information.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Blanket rejection of p-values can also discard useful model/error diagnostics.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Optional stopping; unreported multiplicity; p=0.049 vs 0.051 treated qualitatively different; effect size absent.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Optional stopping; unreported multiplicity; p=0.049 vs 0.051 treated qualitatively different; effect size absent. Contrary evidence/limit: There remains legitimate disagreement over when significance language/thresholds are useful; the rejected claim is universality and sufficiency.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: ASA statements criticise misuse while the 2021 task force explicitly preserves properly applied p-values; the evidence rejects universal threshold ritual, not all tests.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use error thresholds only when tied to a declared family, effect/decision and consequence; otherwise report continuous evidence and uncertainty.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The universal rule is ceremony/rejected; calibrated hypothesis tests remain conditional tools.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: There remains legitimate disagreement over when significance language/thresholds are useful; the rejected claim is universality and sufficiency.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which engineering decision contexts genuinely benefit from a fixed error threshold rather than an explicit loss/interval rule?

EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.HYPOTHESIS_OR_DECISION: No universal hypothesis; valid only inside a specific confirmatory design.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPERIMENTAL_UNIT: As defined by that design.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTION: As required by the design.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.RANDOMISATION_OR_CONTROL: Randomisation/control may support the test but does not make 0.05 universal.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.BLOCKING_OR_STRATIFICATION: As needed.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.REPLICATION_MEANING: Independent units as designed.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.INTERACTION_RISK: Must be considered.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.STOPPING_RULE: Fixed/sequential rule must be explicit.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: Only the design-specific error-control value.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.COST: May be low, but misuse cost high.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Threshold ritual substitutes convention for engineering consequence.
EXPERIMENT_DISCRIMINATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Conditional calibrated test subordinate to effect/uncertainty/decision.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is a conventional p-value cutoff being used as the entire decision rule?
Where are effect magnitude, uncertainty, multiplicity and engineering consequence represented?
Would an equivalence, interval, sequential or deterministic rule answer the decision better?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Control-chart-everything and automatic run-rule escalation
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Textbook/quality-programme simplification of Shewhart SPC and later dashboard practice.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Place every recurring metric on a classical chart and treat every rule violation as an intervention mandate.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Attempts to make variation visible, but assumes a meaningful stream, baseline, measurement and action response that often do not exist.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: False alarms, dashboard overload, worker surveillance/blame, invalid iid limits and tampering.
properties.MECHANISM: No universal mechanism; retain P015–P024 only where a calibrated monitor changes an actionable decision.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Only repeatable, adequately measured processes with an interpretable baseline and response plan.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: One-off heterogeneous work, exact deterministic checks, sparse changing mixtures or metrics without an owner should not trigger classical charting.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable measurement, process identity, dependence model, error costs and response capacity.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Metric must be decision-relevant and evaluator-stable.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Chart/model assumptions and baseline are adequate; alerts are investigated rather than punished.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Conditional charts can improve detection; universal chart deployment has no demonstrated general payoff.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Specific process owner, never a generic surveillance layer.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Alert fatigue, false accusation and self-induced variation.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Refusing all monitoring can miss gradual or recurrent change.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Specs used as limits; many supplementary rules; no action plan; rebaselining; individual ranking on system variation.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Specs used as limits; many supplementary rules; no action plan; rebaselining; individual ranking on system variation. Contrary evidence/limit: Some broad monitoring programmes work organisationally, but benefit cannot be inferred from chart count and may reflect improved attention/process definition.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: SPC literature itself documents assumptions and controversies; evolved practice narrows and adapts chart use.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Monitor only where the stream, signal, cost and response are defensible; otherwise choose a cheaper direct/qualitative method.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The chart/tool is ceremony when detached from a decision; variation discrimination is the property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Some broad monitoring programmes work organisationally, but benefit cannot be inferred from chart count and may reflect improved attention/process definition.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What minimum evidence shows a new chart adds discrimination rather than alert volume?

VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.DECISION_PROBLEM: No universal decision; assess whether a proposed chart adds actionable detection.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.ASSUMED_DATA_GENERATING_PROCESS: Varies; often violated by heterogeneous/adaptive streams.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Must be established before use.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.SIGNAL_OR_DISCRIMINATOR: Incremental detection value over cheap baseline.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_POSITIVE_COST: Dashboard overload, blame and tampering.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.FALSE_NEGATIVE_COST: Missed change if all monitoring rejected.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.NONSTATIONARITY_RISK: Often high.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.INTERVENTION_RISK: Automatic intervention is central hazard.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Direct check, simple plot or case review.
VARIATION_CONTROL_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Only retain calibrated, owned monitors with positive decision value.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does each chart have a defined decision, validated baseline and response owner?
Are run-rule false-alarm costs and dependence accounted for?
Would a direct deterministic check or simple time plot suffice?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Universal 3.4 DPMO or “six-sigma level” as the definition of quality
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Motorola/GE-era Six Sigma rhetoric and capability-index conversion conventions, including the contested 1.5-sigma shift.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Express quality as a universal defects-per-million target associated with a nominal shifted normal process.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Provides a memorable aspiration but compresses defect opportunity, severity, dependence, distribution, stability and measurement into one number.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: False precision, opportunity-count gaming, normal-tail extrapolation, equal treatment of trivial/catastrophic defects and branding substitution.
properties.MECHANISM: No general mechanism; use direct consequence-specific defect/reliability/tail evidence and conditional capability only where prerequisites hold.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A project may choose a defect-rate target when opportunities and consequences are coherent; the branded universal number is not required.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Do not trigger for continuous performance, changing opportunities, unstable/non-normal processes, rare catastrophic modes or deterministic requirements.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable process, valid measurement, fixed opportunity definition, adequate distribution/tail evidence and consequence-relevant target.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Defect classification and opportunity denominators must be stable and resistant to gaming.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Normal/shift model and independence would need support; extrapolation far beyond data remains weak.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: A context-specific defect goal can focus effort; universal 3.4 DPMO has no general engineering validity.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Programme/project owner only after risk justification.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Drives denominator relabelling and unsafe equivalence of defects.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Rejecting all defect-rate goals can lose a useful operational metric.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Counting opportunities strategically; Cpk converted to DPMO under instability; 1.5 shift asserted as law; average defect severity ignored.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Counting opportunities strategically; Cpk converted to DPMO under instability; 1.5 shift asserted as law; average defect severity ignored. Contrary evidence/limit: Historical details of the 1.5-sigma convention vary across practitioner accounts; no strong general evidence makes it a physical/statistical law.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Mature quality engineering retains conditional capability/yield and abandons the number as a universal definition.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Set targets from customer/safety/economic consequences and observed/modelled risk, not brand numerology.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: 3.4 DPMO and “sigma level” are programme rhetoric/conditional conversion, not a surviving general property.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Historical details of the 1.5-sigma convention vary across practitioner accounts; no strong general evidence makes it a physical/statistical law.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: In which narrowly defined high-volume processes is a DPMO target more decision-useful than direct yield/severity/tail reporting?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is the DPMO/sigma claim based on a stable measured process and defensible opportunity count?
Are defect severities and tail/model uncertainty hidden by one number?
Was the target derived from consequences or inherited from branding?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: DMAIC/DMADV phase names and tollgates as a general statistical property
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Six Sigma management-programme translation of earlier problem-solving, quality-control and product-design cycles.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Require work to pass named phases and prescribed tollgates/templates.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Can coordinate roles, preserve sequencing and prevent premature solutioning in large programmes.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Phase compliance replacing evidence, forced linearity, duplicated paperwork and tools chosen to satisfy a gate.
properties.MECHANISM: Underlying properties—problem definition, measurement validation, analysis, intervention, confirmation/control—can be implemented in many forms.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Useful when many teams/projects need common governance and handoffs.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Small/local/deterministic decisions, exploratory science, or established competent workflows need not adopt the names or fixed order.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Real authority at gates, evidence criteria, proportionate templates and ability to iterate/skip non-value steps.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement validity cannot be conferred by reaching the Measure phase.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Programme fit and organisational coordination are adequate; phases permit iteration and exceptions.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: May improve coordination/discipline, but names themselves do not generate valid evidence.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Programme/project governance.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Bureaucracy, delay and false completion.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: No structure can permit premature action or lost evidence in complex programmes.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Tollgate passed on documents; analysis forced after answer known; no iteration; every project uses same tool menu.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Tollgate passed on documents; analysis forced after answer known; no iteration; every project uses same tool menu. Contrary evidence/limit: Observational evidence cannot cleanly separate structured problem solving from brand, training, leadership and selection effects.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Research characterises DMAIC as a problem-solving structure and Six Sigma’s distinctive element as organisational architecture, not unique statistics.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retain evidence dependencies and governance where useful; strip mandatory branding and tailor path to problem risk/uncertainty.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Phase names/tollgates are artefacts, not general properties.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Observational evidence cannot cleanly separate structured problem solving from brand, training, leadership and selection effects.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which coordination benefits persist after removing DMAIC names and mandatory artefacts?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does each phase/tollgate enforce an evidential dependency or merely produce a document?
Can the workflow iterate, skip or use a cheap deterministic path?
Would existing competent governance preserve the same property without the branding?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Belt hierarchy and certification as a general engineering property
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Six Sigma organisational role structure and certification market.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Assign improvement authority/competence through belt ranks and certified tool curricula.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Can create trained specialists, common language, mentoring and protected project capacity.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Credential theatre, consultant dependence, fixed tool menus and authority detached from domain/measurement competence.
properties.MECHANISM: Underlying properties are demonstrated competence, role clarity, independence and capacity—not belt names.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Potentially useful in large deployments needing specialist career/role architecture.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Small teams, mature statistical functions, regulated laboratories or domain specialists may use different competence systems.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Validated competence assessment, domain integration, project evidence, role authority and ongoing learning.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Certification must include measurement/design reasoning, not merely software/tool recall.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Curriculum/assessment predicts competent practice and role structure fits the organisation.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: May improve capability and coordination; certification alone has weak causal evidence.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Organisational leadership and project portfolio governance.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Hierarchy suppresses local expertise, encourages template compliance and creates commercial incentives.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: No specialist capacity can leave complex statistical work unsupported.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Certificate accepted as evidence of method validity; belt owns statistics without process knowledge; project quotas; expired skills.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: Certificate accepted as evidence of method validity; belt owns statistics without process knowledge; project quotas; expired skills. Contrary evidence/limit: Some evidence links experienced teams/structured roles to project success, but credential effects are confounded with selection, resources and leadership.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Organisational research treats role structure as distinctive to Six Sigma, while criticism shows resource/rigidity/theatre risks.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use role/competence systems proportionate to need and assess actual decisions/work products; no required belt taxonomy.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Belt titles/certificates are programme artefacts.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Some evidence links experienced teams/structured roles to project success, but credential effects are confounded with selection, resources and leadership.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What competence evidence predicts high-quality statistical engineering better than course completion?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is a credential being treated as evidence that the measurement/design is valid?
What demonstrated competence and independent review actually protect the decision?
Could existing domain/statistical roles supply the capacity without a belt hierarchy?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: More samples, more reruns or repeated green tests automatically mean more truth
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: A recurring statistical caricature contradicted by sampling, measurement error, dependence, missingness, sequential and adaptive-data theory.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Treat raw observation count or repeated pass count as monotonically increasing confidence regardless of source/dependence/bias.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Averaging can reduce independent random error, but cannot remove shared bias, selection, invalid constructs or common-mode dependence.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: False precision, pseudo-replication, confirmation loops and quota-based evidence theatre.
properties.MECHANISM: Count independent information, model dependence/bias, protect stopping and ask whether the next observation can change the decision.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: No universal trigger; more evidence helps only when it is valid, sufficiently independent and decision-relevant.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Stop when deterministic evidence settles the decision or when another correlated rerun has negligible value.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Valid measurement, representative sampling, independent/new units or valid dependence/sequential model.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement bias and evaluator drift must be bounded; repeated runs are provenance-distinct.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Information increments satisfy the planning model and no outcome-contingent selection/stopping invalidates inference.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Valid additional units improve precision/power; the universal claim is rejected.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Experiment/measurement owner.

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Mandatory normality tests, fixed gauge R&R cutoffs and full MSA paperwork for every metric
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Quality-training/checklist simplification of model diagnostics and measurement-system analysis.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Require standard assumption tests and form thresholds regardless of decision, scale, sample size or measurement mechanism.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Attempts to standardise due diligence but confuses a procedure with evidence of adequacy.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Small-sample non-detection, huge-sample trivial rejection, arbitrary GR&R pass/fail and paperwork without construct validity.
properties.MECHANISM: Replace with decision-sensitive measurement capability, graphical/predictive diagnostics and methods robust to relevant departures.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Use formal tests/designs when a specific assumption or variance component can change the decision.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Skip irrelevant tests for deterministic checks, categorical authoritative outcomes or robust methods; use a concise rationale.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined decision margin, measurement mechanism, model purpose and representative validation conditions.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement study must cover actual range/operators/context rather than satisfy a form.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Diagnostic/test operating characteristics and cutoff relevance are understood.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Targeted checks can prevent invalid inference; mandatory ritual has no general payoff.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Measurement/analysis owner and reviewer.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Unnecessary rejection, delay and false sense of compliance.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Omitting all diagnostics can miss consequential defects.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: p>0.05 called normal; 10% GR&R used universally; easy part range; exact digital check forced into variance study.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: p>0.05 called normal; 10% GR&R used universally; easy part range; exact digital check forced into variance study. Contrary evidence/limit: Some regulated contexts legitimately require standardised evidence for comparability; the critique is indiscriminate use, not all standard protocols.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Mature practice evaluates fitness relative to use and consequential departures, not universal checklist thresholds.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use the smallest diagnostic/MSA design that can falsify decision adequacy.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The mandatory form/cutoff is ceremony; measurement fitness/model adequacy are retained properties.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Some regulated contexts legitimately require standardised evidence for comparability; the critique is indiscriminate use, not all standard protocols.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which standardised diagnostics provide enough cross-site governance value to justify occasional local over-testing?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: What decision would the normality test or GR&R cutoff change?
Does the study span the real decision range and variation sources?
Would a robust method or direct reference comparison be cheaper and stronger?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Universal Taguchi signal-to-noise ratios and orthogonal-array recipes as the definition of robust design
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Taguchi quality-engineering programme and later statistical critique/refinement.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use prescribed S/N criteria and orthogonal arrays as generally optimal robust-design analysis.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Promoted explicit noise-factor design and off-line quality improvement but often imposed inefficient or condition-specific analyses.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Loss of information, confounded effects, wrong mean–variance criterion and ritual array selection.
properties.MECHANISM: Retain P043 robust/noise-factor experimentation; use standard factorial/RSM/direct mean–variance/tail models suited to the objective.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Particular S/N ratios may be useful only when their mean-variance/performance relation matches the engineering loss.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Do not trigger automatically because a problem mentions robustness or noise.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Explicit loss/objective, factor/noise structure, alias analysis, measurement fitness and confirmation.
properties.MEASUREMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Response scale and variance can be estimated separately across representative noise conditions.
properties.ASSUMPTIONS: Chosen criterion has a justified relation to adjustment, mean and variance; array resolution supports interactions of interest.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Robust-design philosophy can be valuable; universal recipe is superseded.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Design/quality engineer.
properties.FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_OVERREACTION_RISK: Discarded information, false optimum and mystique around proprietary/brand rules.
properties.FALSE_NEGATIVE_OR_MISSED_SIGNAL_RISK: Rejecting Taguchi wholesale can lose the important design-for-insensitivity contribution.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: S/N used without loss relation; no interaction/alias analysis; array selected from menu; confirmation absent.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The property is bounded by its stated assumptions and known failures: S/N used without loss relation; no interaction/alias analysis; array selected from menu; confirmation absent. Contrary evidence/limit: Taguchi’s organisational influence and practical success cases are real but do not establish statistical optimality of every prescribed method.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Box/Bisgaard/Fung, León/Shoemaker/Kackar, Nair panel and later practice retained robust parameter design while narrowing/replacing universal S/N methods.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Model the actual mean, variance, tails and noise-factor interactions; use a Taguchi criterion only when demonstrably appropriate.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Universal S/N/array recipe is superseded; robust design remains retained in evolved form.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Taguchi’s organisational influence and practical success cases are real but do not establish statistical optimality of every prescribed method.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which Taguchi-specific criteria remain preferable under clearly stated loss/mean-variance structures?
